corrections.reason: Region contains Hadrian's Wall and County Durham (see its own notes). Marking it a British client 105-142 shows the Wall as non-Roman during its construction (122-128), and 'client' for 369-410 contradicts the Wall's garrisoning into c. 400 (Notitia Occ. 40; coin series at Wall forts). Both periods are direct Roman control of the Wall corridor.

corrections.reason: The 43-55 station was placed in the Midlands (Mancetter area, -1.55/52.57), but its own note and Suetonius Vesp. 4 put II Augusta under Vespasian in the south-west (Durotriges, Isle of Wight). Its base before Exeter was the vexillation fortress at Lake Farm, Dorset (Webster; Frere, Britannia).

corrections.reason: Maurice never took the field in Persia; Theophylact Simocatta 5.9-11 has the Roman army led by Narses (not the eunuch Narses, so no existing person id) and John Mystacon, with Khosrow II present. Commanders changed from maurice to khosrow_ii; Maurice stays in people as sponsor.

corrections.name: Gildo
corrections.reason: Gildo was not killed in battle: after the rout at the Ardalio (398) he fled to Thabraca and hanged himself (Zosimus 5.11.4; Orosius 7.36.13 says strangled after capture). The codex event battle_of_the_ardalio already says he killed himself.
